title: Honey Cashew Muffins
blurb: Tender muffins sweetened with honey and studded with chopped cashews, with a hint of cinnamon warmth.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the egg whites lightly, then stir in the honey, milk and oil until combined.
Chop the cashews roughly into small pieces.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and fold together gently until just combined, then fold in the cashews.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cases, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave to cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
